cards.intuition: Relevant texts can describe the same need with different words, leaving exact lexical coordinates disconnected.
Sparse retrieval excels at exact rare strings; dense retrieval supplies soft matches across paraphrases.
cards.formula: hybrid candidates = lexical strengths + semantic strengths

cards.intuition: Use labeled recall by query type to prove that different wording, rather than missing data or bad filters, loses candidates.

cards.intuition: Compress a weighted word-by-document table into a few strong co-occurrence directions.

cards.intuition: Too few directions blur meanings; too many preserve lexical noise and approach the original matrix.
